129: def _reach(world, query):
130:     whole, part = query["arguments"]["whole"], query["arguments"]["part"]
131:     adjacency = _adjacency(world)
132:     if part in adjacency[whole]:
133:         return {"state": "DIRECT", "via": None}, {
134:             "path": [whole, part], "selection": "DIRECT_EDGE_TAKES_PRECEDENCE"}
135:     if query["rule"] == "first_direct_constituent_lexical_v1":
136:         for first in adjacency[whole]:
137:             suffix, _ = _bfs(adjacency, first, part)
138:             if suffix is not None:
139:                 return {"state": "VIA", "via": first}, {
140:                     "path": [whole] + suffix,
141:                     "selection": "LEXICAL_FIRST_DIRECT_CONSTITUENT_WITH_A_PATH"}
142:         _, visited = _bfs(adjacency, whole, part)
143:     else:
144:         _require(query["rule"] == "bfs_immediate_predecessor_lexical_v1",
145:                  "TYPED_CHECKER_REACH_RULE")
146:         path, visited = _bfs(adjacency, whole, part)
147:         if path is not None:
148:             return {"state": "VIA", "via": path[-2]}, {
149:                 "path": path, "selection": "LEXICAL_BFS_FIRST_PATH_IMMEDIATE_PREDECESSOR"}
150:     return {"state": "ABSENT", "via": None}, {
151:         "reachable_nodes_including_start": visited,
152:         "inventory_scope": world["inventory_scope"],
153:         "selection": "NO_PATH_IN_COMPLETE_SUPPLIED_SNAPSHOT"}

156: def _derive_values(public, query):

158:     focus = worlds[query["focus_world_id"]]
159:     kind = query["kind"]
160:     values, witnesses, coverage = [], [], {}

164:         witnesses.append({"focal_clauses": derived["witnesses"],

166:         coverage = {"clauses_checked": len(derived["witnesses"]),

168:                     "background_and_worked_supports_are_focal": False}
169:     elif kind == "definition":

173:         values.append(value)

178:     elif kind == "context":
179:         values.append({"setting_ref": answers.declaration_ref(focus["world_id"], "setting"),
180:                        "participants": sorted(focus["declarations"]["participants"])})
181:         witnesses.append({"setting": focus["declarations"]["setting"],
182:                           "participants_basis": focus["declarations"]["participants_basis"],
183:                           "reference_rule": "FOCUS_WORLD_DECLARATION_IDENTITY"})
184:     elif kind == "parts":

191:         value = {"edges": _edge_rows(_edges(focus))}
